notes: Hard (total 19). dependent_stages=3: the pipeline has four independent numeric components (dtype-aware softmax, covariance-weighted risk, 1-D transport, log-concave rejection sampler) plus a Python2->Python3 reporting port; every one must land or the verifier rejects. tool_breadth=3: the agent must write numpy numerics with per-dtype stability, handle degenerate transport inputs, run a Monte-Carlo log-concavity check, and do a pathlib/configparser/pandas utf-8 port. reasoning_depth=2: stable softmax (max-shift) and a correct finite-grid log-concavity test must be derived, not copied. adversarial_inputs=3: hidden cases include extreme softmax scores (overflow-prone), empty/single/identical/mismatched distributions, a bimodal target that must be rejected, and n<=0 / non-callable sampler arguments. hidden_case_generalization=3: the verifier imports the solver module and runs every function family on fresh hidden inputs, plus reruns the CLI to regenerate answer.json and the converted reporting script. quantitative_correctness=3: risk must match a float64 reference within rtol=1e-9, attention-sum within per-dtype tolerances (fp64 1e-12, fp32/mixed 1e-5, fp16 2e-3), and the reporting port must match pandas-averaged expectations. Hard bucket requires >=2 in a dimension; reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs, dependent_stages all >=2.
